description: This file contains unit tests for the onboarding remote authentication prompt features, including error code mappings, UI visibility rules, user copy text, and success message verifications.

classes.name: OnboardingRemoteAuthPromptTests
classes.description: A struct containing various test functions for onboarding remote authentication prompts.

methods.name: auth detail codes map to remote auth issues
methods.description: Tests mapping of specific auth error detail codes to remote gateway auth issues.

methods.name: password detail family maps to password required issue
methods.description: Verifies that password-related error codes map to the password required issue.

methods.name: token field visibility follows onboarding rules
methods.description: Checks the logic controlling visibility of the remote token field based on various conditions.

methods.name: pairing required copy points users to pair approve
methods.description: Ensures the UI copy for pairing required issues points users to the correct command.

methods.name: paired device success copy explains auth source
methods.description: Verifies titles and details for different successful device pairing/authentication sources.

methods.name: transient probe mode restore does not clear probe feedback
methods.description: Tests whether specific probe modes reset feedback or not.
